This appeal has been filed on behalf of the appellant under Section 374(2) read with Section 389(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (hereinafter referred to as the Code) against the judgment of conviction dated 06.02.2023 and order of sentence dated 10.02.2023 rendered by the learned Additional Sessions Judge- VI cum Special Judge POCSO Act Muzaffarpur in POCSO G.R.
No. 01 of 2021 arising out of Patna High Court CR.

sentences.text: Learned Advocate for the appellant submits that as the Trial Court has convicted the appellant under Section 376(3) of the IPC, as per provisions contained in Section 374(4) of the Code, the appeal filed by the appellant is required to be heard within a stipulated time.

Learned Advocate,
therefore, urged that the present appeal be fixed for "Hearing".
4.

In view of the aforesaid request made by learned Advocate and in view of the provisions contained in 374 (4) of Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.481 of 2023(10) dt.14-03-2024 the Code, the Office is directed to prepare the paper-book immediately and thereafter list the present Appeal under the heading for "Hearing" in the week commencing from 24 th June, 2024.
5. As this Court has fixed the appeal for hearing, learned Advocate for the appellant does not press the prayer for grant of bail, for the present.
6. Accordingly, the prayer is not entertained for the present.
It is clarified that we have not examined the merits of the case of the appellant.
It is further clarified that if the present appeal is not heard before 31st August, 2024, it is open for the appellant to file separate Interlocutory Application under Section 389(1) of the Code.

(Vipul M. Pancholi, J) ( Sunil Dutta Mishra, J) GKS/-
